text:
maria.g: Auditor Morgan from Cygnus just opened an evidence request for SOC 2 — asking for KMS/HSM rotation logs, CloudTrail audit log exports for the last 12 months, and the retention policy that covers those logs. They need preliminary evidence by EOD Fri. Can someone own? :exclamation:

alex.k: I can pull KMS key rotation records and the CloudTrail exports. Will need the exact scope: all accounts or just production?

auditor_morgan: Hi team, thanks. We need: (1) KMS key rotation/creation/deletion events for org-owned CMKs (prod & shared) for last 12 months, (2) CloudTrail event deliveries showing retention/immutable storage configuration, (3) proof of HSM usage for key material if any (policy + screenshots), (4) evidence that logging ingestion and retention are monitored (alerts, runbooks). Prefer CSVs and signed hashes.

maria.g: Prod + shared is sufficient for now. No need for dev. Also we need the control mapping doc (which control each artifact supports) — Priya, can compliance-team provide the mapping template?

priya: Yep. I'll attach the control matrix template and map CC6, CC7 rows to each artifact. Linking draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Pack+Template

sec-bot: Incident/Request created: INC-2026-0315-42 — SOC2 evidence request from auditor. Assigned to: alex.k, jonathan. Due: 2026-03-20 23:59 UTC.

alex.k: Quick notes on exports: for KMS rotation events we should query CloudTrail with: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2025-03-15 --end-time 2026-03-15 --query Events
```
I'll run this against the prod account and stash CSVs at s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026-03-15/kms-rotation-prod.csv.gz with sha256 in the same folder.

jonathan: I'll pull CloudTrail S3 delivery/config history and the S3 object lock versioning config screenshots. For HSM proof: we don't use external HSMs currently; we use AWS KMS backed by AWS-managed HSMs (AWS CloudHSM). I'll export the key policy docs and the KMS key metadata (key origin: AWS_KMS vs EXTERNAL). Example command for key metadata: 
```
aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id> --query '{KeyId:KeyMetadata.KeyId,Origin:KeyMetadata.Origin,CreationDate:KeyMetadata.CreationDate}'
```

maria.g: Reminder: do NOT include any plaintext key material or secrets in the outputs. Auditor asked for screenshots of the KMS console for policies and rotation dates, which is fine.

auditor_morgan: For HSMs we accept evidence showing AWS CloudHSM clusters + KMS key origin=AWS_CLOUDHSM. Screenshots + audit logs are fine. Also please provide the retention config for CloudTrail (S3 lifecycle + Glacier rules) and any immutable storage proofs (S3 Object Lock / governance mode).

alex.k: Noted. Plan: 1) extract KMS events & metadata, 2) export CloudTrail events to CSV, 3) export S3 bucket policies and lifecycle configs, 4) capture console screenshots for KMS origin and S3 object lock. I'll upload to the S3 evidence bucket and post links here when done.

priya: I'll pre-fill the control mapping: which evidence file corresponds to SOC 2 CC6.1/CC6.2/CC7.3 etc. Auditor wants chain-of-custody: who pulled the data and when. Include the runbook entry and ticket refs.

maria.g: Alex/Jonathan — please prefix filenames with INC-2026-0315-42 and include your username in the metadata CSV header (pulled_by, pulled_at, command_used). Example CSV header: 
`pulled_by,pulled_at,command_used,sha256,path`

alex.k: Will do. Also flagging one potential repro: last week we had a customer report about intermittent 401s during key-auth rotation window. Do we need to include the incident postmortem?

maria.g: Yes include a short summary and link to postmortem if it affects controls (auth availability/process). Postmortem link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INC/2026-03-08-401-key-rotation

jonathan: FYI repro steps for the 401: 
1) Triggered by a key rotation job running at 02:00 UTC on 2026-03-08
2) Some service instances had cached KMS client configuration for 5m longer than expected
3) Error observed: `AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to use key` in logs
Logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-08T02:03:12Z svc-auth ERROR AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
Mitigation: rollback to previous key alias and run coordinated cache flush. Fixed within 17 minutes.

priya: Include that timeline and the change control ticket (CHG-2026-03108-9). Auditor will want to see that we have rollback procedures and change approvals.

auditor_morgan: Good. Also can you provide evidence of monitoring/alerts that would detect failed key uses? E.g., CloudWatch alarm screenshots or alert history linking to PagerDuty incidents.

alex.k: I'll include CloudWatch alarm definitions and a PagerDuty incident export for the 03-08 event. PD incident: PD-14258.

maria.g: If we can get a draft package by EOD Thu that would be ideal — gives us a day to review before auditor deadline. Who can do an internal review? @compliance-team?

compliance-team: We can review on Thu morning. Please upload all artifacts to s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/INCS/INC-2026-0315-42/draft/ and ping us. We'll check control mapping and redact any PII.

alex.k: Uploading now. Files: 
- s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/INCS/INC-2026-0315-42/draft/kms-rotation-prod-INC-2026-0315-42.csv.gz
- s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/INCS/INC-2026-0315-42/draft/cloudtrail-prod-2025-03-15_2026-03-15.csv.gz
- s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/INCS/INC-2026-0315-42/draft/kms-console-screenshots.zip
- s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/INCS/INC-2026-0315-42/draft/s3-lifecycle-config.json
SHA256s uploaded as .sha256 files alongside each artifact.

maria.g: Thank you. Priya/compliance-team please review and then I'll coordinate delivery to Morgan.

auditor_morgan: Received. We'll review once you send the final package. Quick ask: please include a signed hash or GPG-signed manifest if possible to prove integrity across transfer.

alex.k: I'll GPG-sign the manifest and upload manifest.sig.

maria.g: Great. Let's keep this thread for status updates. If anything blocks, escalate to me or @jonathan. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: Review reminder for compliance-team on 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC.
